title: Legal Acceptance Event
description: Immutable Firestore document for the legalAcceptanceEvents collection. Firestore rules must DENY update and delete on this collection.

documentHash.description: SHA-256 of the document text at time of acceptance. Protects against silent post-acceptance edits.

summaryShown.description: Plain-English summary shown to the user at time of acceptance (max 150 words).

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. Captured at acceptance time for jurisdiction analytics.
